thread:
olivia (sec-eng): Heads-up — we're planning an audit event schema change next quarter: adding `actor_origin`, removing `legacy_client_id`. Need a versioning + shim strategy and a customer onboarding flow. Who's available to own parts of this?
kevin (platform): +1. Proposal: treat this as a major compatibility bump: introduce `event_version` field, default old events to v1, new shape v2. Implement gateway shim that rewrites v1 -> v2 for internal consumers. Feature-flag rollout.
marta (api): KMS questions: will the actor identifier stay encrypted? if we change field names we may need to include key metadata (key_id or key_version) so decryptors can handle both. Also, are we removing PII when we change shape?
raj (customer-sre): Customers will want sample payloads + validators. We should run compatibility checks against top customers' webhooks before cutover. Also: update RBAC mapping — `actor_role` is being expanded so downstream permission checks must be updated in audit pipeline.
olivia (sec-eng): Good notes. I'll draft runbook: prerequisites, detection, rollback windows. Timeline idea: canary -> 5% (1d) -> 25% (2d) -> 100% (1d) if no errors. Gate by feature flag `audit_v2`.
kevin (platform): Shim sketch (pseudo):
```
# gateway shim (pseudo)
if event.get('event_version') is None or event['event_version'] == 1:
    event['actor_origin'] = event.get('legacy_client_id') or 'unknown'
    event.pop('legacy_client_id', None)
    event['event_version'] = 2
# pass downstream
```
Keep the shim lightweight and idempotent.
marta (api): For KMS: we can reuse the same KMS key but must add `kms_key_id` to envelope. That lets consumers call decrypt with correct key version. Also need to update docs about deterministic vs. randomized encryption for actor_id.
raj (customer-sre): For customer validation: I'll write a small validator service that accepts a sample payload and runs schema checks + signature verification. Plan: run nightly validation against top-50 customers and open tickets for mismatches. Also propose a compatibility header `X-Audit-Compat: v1` so customers can opt into older shape for a period.
olivia (sec-eng): On RBAC: updating `actor_role` requires coordination with Identity team; map old roles to new enum values in the shim layer too so downstream checks don't break. Add a test matrix in the runbook: role mapping + encryption variants + missing fields.
kevin (platform): CI tasks: add unit tests for shim, e2e test that simulates both v1 and v2 and verifies downstream consumers see v2. I'll own gateway deploy + canary.
marta (api): I'll own docs + customer migration guide + sample curl/payloads. Will include example payloads for both v1 and v2 and a small Node/Go validator snippet. 👍
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: `audit-shim-service v0.1.0` -> canary 5% at 03:00 UTC (automated)
raj (customer-sre): Also note compliance: if customers request export of legacy audit events, we need an export adapter that preserves `legacy_client_id` so nothing is lost. Add to runbook.
olivia (sec-eng): OK let's meet 13:00 tomorrow to align owners and timeline. I'll post meeting link in calendar. Short action items: Kevin: shim + canary plan; Marta: docs + KMS guidance; Raj: validator + customer-runbook; Olivia: runbook + RBAC mapping.
kevin (platform): ACK.
marta (api): ACK, starting drafts.
raj (customer-sre): ACK, will queue nightly run.
olivia (sec-eng): Thanks — we'll aim for non-breaking rollout. If anyone spots a critical case (PII or KMS caveat) ping me directly.
